task_contract.domain: Software operations tickets only; medical or unrelated business requests are unknown.

labels.urgent: An active production outage is asserted to affect end users.
labels.routine: An in-domain ticket does not assert such an outage, including explicit denial or planned tests.
labels.unknown: Out of domain or insufficient information to decide.

task_contract.quoted_text: A quoted old message does not override the author's explicit current status.
task_contract.conditions: Evaluate the short texts as written. Do not infer status from ticket IDs. All supplied texts fit within the context budget.

tickets.text: Production is down now and all end users cannot log in.
Production is down now and all end users cannot log in. Internal ticket number: 314.
Production is not down now; all end users can log in. This is a planned failover test.
An old message said "production is not down". Current status: production is down now and all end users cannot log in.
Please triage a patient with chest pain.
Someone mentioned a possible problem. No system, impact, or current status is available.

proposed_shortcuts: Every insertion of the word not must flip the label.
Appending any text must leave a label unchanged.
Every ticket must be forced into urgent or routine.
